policies.summary: The Central Library houses over 50,000 volumes, 10,000+ titles, and operates from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM on all working days.
policies.details: The library is fully automated using barcode management. It subscribes to national and international print journals, reference books, GATE/GRE preparation materials, and newspapers. Circulation section allows borrowing of up to 4 books for undergraduate students for 14 days renewal period.
policies.actionable: Use student RFID smart card to check out and return books at the circulation desk.

policies.summary: The Digital Library provides 30+ high-speed workstations with access to IEEE Xplore, DELNET, NPTEL, and National Digital Library of India (NDLI).
policies.details: High-bandwidth Wi-Fi and wired internet facilitate research paper downloads, e-books, and video lectures. Students have access to institutional repositories and open access journals for project and research documentation.
policies.actionable: Log into the digital library terminals using your student credentials to access IEEE Xplore and DELNET databases.
